name: The Kiprun Singapore 2026
short_description: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon event on September 27, 2026, in Kallang, Singapore, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Kallang, Singapore. Organized by MetaSport and presented by Decathlon Singapore, the race offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and a 0.67km event, based at the Decathlon Singapore Lab. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining any of these distances.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 0.67km) to suit different runner levels
Registration is currently open, allowing ample time to prepare
Organized by MetaSport and presented by Decathlon Singapore, a known sporting goods brand
Centrally located venue at Decathlon Singapore Lab, Kallang
research_highlights: This is the inaugural edition of The Kiprun Singapore — organised by MetaSport and presented by Decathlon Singapore, held for the first time on 27 September 2026, so there is no participant track record from past editions to draw on.
Four race categories are offered: a 21.1km Half Marathon, 10km Run, 5km Run, and a 670m Kids Dash.
The event village and race start/finish are based at the Decathlon Singapore Lab near the National Stadium in Kallang.
Organisers have promoted Super Early Bird pricing starting from S$78 for the Half Marathon, S$60 for the 10km, and S$10 for the Kids Dash, pitched as below typical market rates for Singapore races.

Organisers describe the course as designed with wide roads and minimal turns, structured wave starts, and 5km timing splits aimed at a fast, PB-friendly experience — though this reflects race marketing rather than participant-verified course reports.
research_watchouts: As of the most recent checks, official certified route maps had not yet been released by organisers, so course specifics (turns, surface, exact elevation) are not independently confirmed.
Because this is a brand-new, first-year event, there are no participant race reports, reviews, or community discussion yet covering actual race-day execution, crowd support, or logistics.

Some published 'preview' articles about this race speculate on course location (e.g. Marina Bay area) based on promotional imagery rather than confirmed route details — prospective participants should treat such details as unconfirmed.

faqs.question: When is The Kiprun Singapore 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026. The event will be held in Kallang, Singapore, at the Decathlon Singapore Lab venue, and is organized by MetaSport in partnership with Decathlon Singapore for participants of various running distances.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon as the primary distance, along with 10km, 5km, and a shorter 0.67km event, catering to a range of runner experience levels and fitness goals.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at the Decathlon Singapore Lab, located in Kallang, Singapore. This venue serves as the central hub for The Kiprun Singapore 2026, hosting all distance categories including the 21.1km half-marathon, 10km, 5km, and the 0.67km event for participants.

faqs.question: Who organizes The Kiprun Singapore 2026?
faqs.answer: The Kiprun Singapore 2026 is organized by MetaSport, presented by Decathlon Singapore. This partnership brings together event management expertise and a well-known sporting goods retailer to deliver the race, which includes multiple distances held at the Decathlon Singapore Lab in Kallang.
